I
nnovative, Student-Centric Curriculum:  Experience unparalleled learning
flexibility tailored to your unique needs and goals.  
Global Opportunities:  Embrace the world with options for full-semester or year-
long international/domestic internships during your senior year.
Advanced Learning Tools:  Dive into embedded, simulation-based courses,
project/problem-based learning, MOOCs/SOOCs, and virtual laboratories like
Coursera / MATLAB  with anytime, anywhere access.
Personalised Education:  Options for Self-Designed courses in Programme / Open
Electives and options for Self-Designed course baskets for Minors in Computer & AI.
Exclusive Enrichment Spaces:  Gain additional knowledge, enhance skills, and get
insights into entrepreneurship and startups in our integrated add-on spaces.
Career Launchpad & Global Alumni Network:  Placement opportunities in
reputed MNCs backed by a well-placed alumni network across the globe.
Skill Development & Certification:  Hands-on training in industry-standard
technical tools like MatLab, ANSYS, NIPM student certification, and start-up
mentoring. 
Holistic Growth & Personalised Support:  Thrive in a vibrant campus life —
organize and perform in cultural fests, competitions, and receive one-on-one
mentoring to discover and refine your unique strengths.

Saintgits leads Kerala’s innovation frontier:
Kerala’s first Concrete Canoe, first Electric All-
terrain Vehicle, first Autonomous All-terrain
Vehicle, and the first team from Kerala to win a title
in SAE Baja. As a true hub of innovation, Saintgits
nurtures award-winning startups and stands tall as
the first-ever Kerala team to represent India at the
ASCE Society-Wide Competitions in the USA.
